trial_court: Family Court, Sunder Nagar, District Mandi, H.P.
case_name: Vinod vs. Manju, H.M. Misc. Petition No. 43/2025
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2023. The respondent filed a divorce petition under Section 13(1)(i)(a) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The petitioner seeks transfer of the case from the Family Court to another court.

legal_principles.principle: In a case where the wife seeks transfer of the petition, then as against husband's convenience, it is the wife's convenience that must be looked at.
legal_principles.held: It is a settled principle of law that in a case where the wife seeks transfer of the petition, then as against husband's convenience, it is the wife's convenience that must be looked at.
cited_cases: Urvashi Rana Vs Himanshu Nayyar, (2016) Latest HLJ (HP) 925

legal_principles.principle: The cardinal principle for exercise of power under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure is that the ends of justice should demand the transfer of the suit, appeal or other proceeding.
legal_principles.held: In matrimonial matters, wherever Courts are called upon to consider the plea of transfer, the Courts have to take into consideration the economic soundness of both the parties, the social strata of the spouses and their behavioural pattern, their standard of life prior to the marriage and subsequent thereto and the circumstances
cited_cases: N.C.V. Aishwarya versus A.S. Saravana Karthik Sha, (2022) Civil Appeal No. 4894

outcome.final_order: The case was transferred to the Court of learned Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Bilaspur, District Bilaspur, H.P.

use_for_drafting: assisting with transfer of case between courts
